description:
PRIVATE RESORT ESTATE | WATERSLIDE • GROTTO • SPLASH PAD • PICKLEBALL • CASITA

Welcome to one of Scottsdale's most extraordinary private resort estates—an immersive luxury retreat designed for unforgettable family vacations, group getaways, corporate retreats, and celebrations.

Set on an expansive estate, this one-of-a-kind property features a stunning 7-bedroom 5main residence paired with a private 2-bedroom casita, creating the perfect balance of togetherness and privacy for larger groups.
amenities: Children’s books and toys for ages 0-2 years old, 2-5 years old, and 5-10 years old
